Name: Automatic Seeding System
Author: K1ngmak1r
Description:
[heading]Description[/heading]
[b]Automatic Seeding System[/b] brings automated crop planting to Stardew Valley!
Turn your farm into a smart agricultural system with upgradeable seeders, connected seed chests, and automatic crop planting.
Assign numbered chests to your seeders, choose which seeds each device should plant, and let the system handle the repetitive work. Multiple seeders can share the same chest, allowing you to manage large farming areas efficiently.
Start with a simple Primitive Seeder from the beginning of the game and unlock more advanced seeders as your Farming skill increases.
Everything is managed through a convenient [b]F7 Control Panel[/b], featuring device management, customizable connections, seed selection, and optional watering.
Designed to integrate with Stardew Valley's existing gameplay and visual style.
[line]
[heading]Installation Instructions[/heading]
[b]Manual Installation[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install Stardew Valley 1.6.14 or newer.[/*]
[*]Install SMAPI 4.5.0 or newer.[/*]
[*]Download the latest version of Automatic Seeding System.[/*]
[*]Extract the downloaded ZIP file.[/*]
[*]Place the mod folder inside your Stardew Valley
[code]Mods[/code]directory.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Press [b]F7[/b] in-game to open the control panel.[/*]
[/list][b]Vortex Installation[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Download the mod using Vortex.[/*]
[*]Install and enable the mod.[/*]
[*]Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list][b]Updating[/b]
Install the new version over the previous version. Existing configuration settings, registered devices, and connections are designed to remain intact.
No manual DLL compilation or .NET SDK installation is required for the precompiled Nexus release.
[line]
[heading]Main Features[/heading]
Automatic Seeding
[list]
[*]Automatically plants seeds in suitable, empty, tilled soil.[/*]
[*]Uses actual seeds stored in connected chests.[/*]
[*]Supports configurable scanning intervals.[/*]
[*]Remembers selected seed types when supplies run out.[/*]
[*]Resumes planting when the selected seeds are restocked.[/*]
[/list]Upgradeable Seeders
Four progression levels are available:
[list]
[*][b]Primitive Seeder[/b] — Available from the beginning.[/*]
[*][b]Basic Seeder[/b] — Unlocks at Farming Level 2.[/*]
[*][b]Quality Seeder[/b] — Unlocks at Farming Level 6.[/*]
[*][b]Iridium Seeder[/b] — Unlocks at Farming Level 9.[/*]
[/list]Each tier offers improved planting coverage. Upgrade existing seeders or craft advanced versions after unlocking their recipes.
Smart Chest Connections
[list]
[*]Register seed chests using unique identification numbers.[/*]
[*]Connect multiple seeders to a single chest.[/*]
[*]Reassign seeders to different chests whenever needed.[/*]
[*]Manage connections directly from the control panel.[/*]
[*]Assign custom names to registered chests and seeders.[/*]
[/list]Individual Seed Selection
[list]
[*]Choose a specific seed type for each seeder.[/*]
[*]Assign different crops to different devices.[/*]
[*]View available seed quantities.[/*]
[*]Change seed assignments without replacing your devices.[/*]
[/list]Optional Automatic Watering
[list]
[*]Enable or disable automatic watering.[/*]
[*]Includes optional Beach Farm watering support.[/*]
[*]Manage watering independently from seed planting.[/*]
[/list]Three-Page Control Panel
Press [b]F7[/b] to access:
[list=1]
[*][b]Settings[/b] — Configure automation, watering, scanning intervals, and keyboard shortcuts.[/*]
[*][b]Connections[/b] — Manage registered chests, seeders, names, connections, and upgrades.[/*]
[*][b]Seed Selection[/b] — Assign specific seed types to individual seeders.[/*]
[/list]Multilingual Support
Automatic language selection based on Stardew Valley's language settings:
[list]
[*]English (default)[/*]
[*]Turkish (Türkçe)[/*]
[*]Simplified Chinese (简体中文)[/*]
[/list]Unsupported languages automatically fall back to English.
Persistent Save Data
Registered chests, seeder assignments, upgrades, and custom names are designed to persist between gaming sessions.
[line]
[heading]Requirements[/heading]
[b]Required:[/b]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6.14 or newer[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.5.0 or newer[/*]
[/list][b]Additional Information:[/b]
[list]
[*]No additional gameplay mods are required.[/*]
[*]No Content Patcher installation is required.[/*]
[*]Uses existing Stardew Valley visual assets.[/*]
[*]A precompiled DLL is included.[/*]
[*]No separate .NET SDK is needed for installation.[/*]
[/list][b]Important:[/b] Back up your save files before installing or updating gameplay-modifying mods.
